QuestInfo.name: Lilin's Reaction
QuestInfo.0: The Black Wings are a bunch of hoodlums who collect Seal Stones... Tell #b#p1201000##k and ask her for advice.
QuestInfo.1: When #p1201000# receives the information you acquired in #m310000000#, she's surprised, yet accepts it easily. It's as if she expected it... #p1201000# requests that you continue to hide your identity and collect more information. She warns you not to do anything rash, since you could get yourself hurt by going on the attack alone.
